title: fix(plugin-auth)!: the SSO domain check refuses a subdomain listed beside its parent, and compares one spelling
body:
Fixes #32308

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none


> Declaration corrected by the seat (card comment on #32308): the newly refused shapes were accepted before, so this is the narrowing arm, as contract review 6771575242 graded the same refusal class on this door. The changeset's BREAKING banner, ADR-0087 marker and the dogfood battery follow in the dev's patch round.
## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：SSO 提供方的"同一域名只能一个"检查补了两种漏判：多域名列表里的子域与父域并存（两种注册顺序都拒），以及同一域名的不同写法（Unicode 与 punycode、末尾的点）；另补一个 N6 测试，并按裁决改了 N7 的一行注释。
- 为什么改：厂商按"整值精确匹配，否则按存储行序取第一个列表匹配"路由；列表里的子域赢不了第一步，于是由行序决定，第二个提供方按地址不一定能被找到。
- 风险与回滚：只会多拒绝注册和域名修改，不放行任何今天被拒的请求；已存的提供方不受影响。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/sso-provider-lifecycle.ts`（`findSsoDomainClaim`，parent/child 两段判断）、`sso-provider-lifecycle.test.ts`（新增四个用例及对照）、`auth-manager.ts`（调用改为传原始域名值）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/sso-provider-lifecycle.test.ts`，预期 23 个用例全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。N3a（并发注册）未修，原因记在卡上，见下文。

## What changes

`assertSsoProviderDomainFree` already refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`field: 'domain'`) an exact domain entry another provider lists. This PR closes N2 and N3b of contract review 6774898717 and records why N3a stays open.

**Measured vendor routing** (`@better-auth/sso` 1.7.12, `/sign-in/sso`, read from the installed `dist/index.mjs`): step 1 is `findOne({ domain: EMAIL_DOMAIN })`, an equality on the whole stored value; step 2 is `findMany({ model: 'ssoProvider' })` with no `sortBy`, then `.find(domainMatches)` (an entry equal to the domain, or the domain ending with `.` plus the entry). The adapter passes no `orderBy` when no `sortBy` is given, so "first" at step 2 is the store's row order, which no contract fixes. That is the reading the review had from the diff, confirmed against the code.

- **N2 fixed.** `findSsoDomainClaim` now reads every provider row and returns one of three kinds. `exact` is the old rule. `parent`: the request lists a subdomain, does not win step 1 for it (its value is a list, or another spelling of the entry), and another provider lists the parent. `child`: the request lists a parent of an entry another provider holds in a list (or in another spelling). The refusal is judged in both registration orders because row order is not registration order. Each kind has its own message naming the remedy; `code`, `status`, `field` and the `heldBy` rule are unchanged.
- **N3b fixed.** The store read is no longer narrowed by `$icontains` on the requested spelling. Every entry on both sides goes through one `bareDomain`, which yields the URL parser's lower-case ASCII host (punycode for an internationalised name) and now also drops a trailing root dot, as the vendor's own parse (`tldts`) does. The trailing dot rides on the same normalisation function and the same pins (same defect class, mechanical, in the claimed file). The refusal message shows the Unicode form beside the ASCII one when they differ.
- **N3a not fixed: recorded.** Measured: the vendor's `/sso/register` runs no `runWithTransaction`, and this adapter deliberately opens native transactions only inside SCIM requests (the header in `objectql-adapter.ts` records that unscoped transactions deadlocked single-connection sqlite pools). A unique index on `sys_sso_provider.domain` sees whole values only, so it misses list entries, parents and spellings, and it would fail schema sync on any deployment that already holds duplicate rows. A per-domain claim table needs a backfill (a data migration) and still cannot express the parent rule. An in-process mutex covers one node only. None is safe without a data migration, so no partial guard ships; the options are in the report on the card.
- **N6.** A new pin edits an OIDC provider with `skip_user_info` on through `POST /admin/sso/update-provider`: the stored `userInfoEndpoint` survives the vendor's member-wise merge, no parked member is stored, and the vendor still reads the config without it.
- **N7.** The `assertSsoProviderDeletable` doc comment now says "users with no other sign-in method linked", the wording ruled in 6774913023.

The exact-collision message's remedy now says a subdomain is accepted "as a provider's only entry", which is what the rule now is. The two phrases the existing test pins ("would not be reached by address", "Register it under its own domain entry") are unchanged.

## Tests

`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/sso-provider-lifecycle.test.ts`, on the real engine, `AuthManager`, `sso()` plugin and route registration:

- refused, `409` + `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` + `field: 'domain'` + `heldBy`: `eng.acme.example, foo.example`, `https://eng.acme.example` and `Eng.Acme.example` beside a provider for `acme.example`; the parent `globex.example` beside a provider listing `eng.globex.example, globex.io`; a domain edit adding `eng.acme.example` to another provider's list; `xn--bcher-kva.example` beside a stored `bücher.example`; `MÜNCHEN.example` and `xn--mnchen-3ya.example.` beside a stored `xn--mnchen-3ya.example`. Nothing is written in each case.
- controls that stay accepted: the existing single-entry subdomain beside its parent, both ways round (unchanged); `xacme.example, foo.example` beside `acme.example`; `bucher.example` beside `bücher.example`.
- N6 as above.

## Acceptance notes

- Not filed: with a parent `acme.com` and a child provider whose whole domain is `eng.acme.com` (the ruled-accepted configuration), a deeper name such as `x.eng.acme.com` matches both lists at step 2, so row order picks. The module comment now says so instead of claiming the parent serves every other subdomain. It is the ruled configuration, so it is left as it is.
- Not filed: the vendor's step-2 read goes through this adapter's `findMany` with no `limit`, which the adapter turns into `limit || 100`; past 100 providers, step 2 sees only the first 100 rows. Read only from the code, not exercised.
